summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of 3 NEW features (Typing Hint, Followed Section Cue, Quick Sign Out) + regressions on Kodama Talk. Cleared kodama-talk/* localStorage, unlocked /alex with password 'secret'. All 3 NEW features PASS. All regressions PASS except one attribution label mismatch on anonymous send.

ui_bugs.issue: After choosing send-identity-toggle -> send-as-anonymous and sending, the message fragment shows only the timestamp (e.g. 'now') with NO 'You · anonymously' (or any 'anonymously') label attached to that outgoing bubble. Named/place sends correctly show 'You'. Spec required fragment to read 'You · anonymously'.

action_items: Fix anonymous outgoing message attribution label: render 'You · anonymously' (or equivalent visible marker) on fragments posted via send-as-anonymous so the sender can see the identity used, matching the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: Typing hint timing tightly coupled to setTimeout (~2.4s on / ~5.4s off) — consider adding a data attribute/state so tests aren't purely time-based.
Owner-return-wrap only exposes lock-device on the landing page; consider surfacing it in the Shelf header as well for one-tap sign-out from any screen.
test_credentials: /alex owner password: 'secret' (any 4+ char string works per mock).
seed_data_creation: None; used built-in mock data (Mara direct, studio-notes channel).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) typing-hint appears ~3s after send in Direct Talk only, auto-dismisses; read-receipt shows ~1.5s post-send (poll rather than one-shot wait). (2) Following studio/notes then returning shows following-cue on stream-item-conv-conv-studio-notes; own channels (updates/field-notes/announcements/ask-alex) show no cue. (3) On landing (/) header owner-return-wrap contains lock-device; clicking it fully signs out (owner-return count 0, /alex shows this-is-me visitor door, shelf-rail count 0). (4) Channel composer (/studio/notes channel-reply-input + channel-reply-send) correctly shows NEITHER typing-hint NOR read-receipt. (5) Suggestions + drop create/open a Mara direct talk in the inline split-pane WITHOUT changing URL (stays /alex) — do not assert URL change on drop. (6) Anonymous send label bug — see frontend_issues.
rca of the issue: Anonymous send: drop-composer-send with send-as-anonymous posts the message content but the fragment header/label omits the 'anonymously' descriptor. Likely the identity label branch in stream-view/stream-item fragment render only labels 'You' for non-anonymous identity and outputs an empty/whitespace author on anonymous, dropping both name and 'anonymously' suffix instead of rendering 'You · anonymously' as the visible attribution for the sender's own view.
